title: Bare /api/* → BFF on portal-static-edge (unblock apex org finder)
description:
## Problem
CloudFront on portal-static-edge only has ordered_cache_behavior for `/*/api/*` (path-first tenant and platform APIs). Bare paths used by apex public discovery never match and fall through to the S3 SPA default behavior:

- `POST /api/public/tenants/resolve` → S3 HTML (not BFF JSON)
- `GET /api/*` without a tenant segment → S3 HTML

Portal product code for apex organization finder is on main (portal-8rk.7–.11). Staging proof portal-8rk.12 is FAIL CLOSED until edge routes bare `/api/*` to BFF.

## Goal
In **lanyard-platform/deploy** (not the legacy company-brain-deploy repo):

1. Keep existing `/*/api/*` → BFF behavior.
2. Add a second ordered_cache_behavior for bare `/api/*` → same BFF origin, same CachingDisabled + origin request policy, full methods including POST.
3. Document dual patterns in module README/variables/outputs and staging runbooks.
4. Do not invent digests or apply live AWS from CI; operator apply remains private roots.

## Out of scope
- Portal SPA/BFF/CP product code (already on main).
- Publishing image/static pins (Portal release workflows + private pin update — separate operator work after this edge PR merges).
- Replacing `/*/api/*` with only `/api/*` (would break path-first tenant APIs).

## Context
- Module: `deploy/modules/portal-static-edge/`
- Staging: `deploy/environments/platform-staging/main.tf` (`api_path_pattern = "/*/api/*"`)
- Live evidence: portal-8rk.12 proof / curl on app.withlanyard.com
acceptance_criteria: Bare /api/* routes to BFF in module; /*/api/* preserved; docs/runbooks updated; PR merged to monorepo; offline terraform validate/smoke green.
notes:
Driver: Portal portal-8rk.12 FAIL CLOSED (bare /api/* not on CF). SoT: lanyard-platform/deploy only — not company-brain-deploy.
Operator applied 2026-07-26: CF dual path live; BFF/CP digests rolled; static web v0.1.3-8rk-finder synced; portal-8rk.12 PASS on app.withlanyard.com.
close_reason: Module+docs+PR shipped (#120–#123). Staging apply done: bare /api/* live; resolve JSON on app.withlanyard.com; unblocked portal-8rk.12 PASS.

title: product/backend: active human edit versus agent write policy
description:

## Required Skills

[ ] Policy says what happens when an agent wants to write a file open in an edit session.
[ ] Default behavior is staged copy or explicit confirmation, not blind overwrite.
[ ] BFF can detect active dirty Office session or conservative active edit ownership.
